findings.rationale: MD's uploaded updates have near-zero norm in roughly 11 of 20 rounds (norm_ratio about 0 to 0.03, i.e. the global model returned without training), alternating with normal-sized updates (norm_ratio about 1.1-1.6) in the other rounds. Round 1 is already near zero. The median norm ratio is z=-11.8 after size adjustment. Local performance is normal (AUC 0.824, CITL -0.004 at round 20), which fits a free rider that receives the correct global model, not a data fault.

OH's updates have near-zero norm in about 12 of 20 rounds (norm_ratio 0 to 0.07), alternating with normal updates (norm_ratio about 1.3-1.7). The median norm ratio is z=-9.2. Round 1 is already near zero. Local AUC and calibration at round 20 look normal (AUC 0.8015, CITL -0.013), consistent with free-riding rather than label or data corruption.

SC's updates have near-zero norm in about 12 of 20 rounds (norm_ratio 0 to 0.06), alternating with normal updates (norm_ratio about 0.7-1.2). The median norm ratio is z=-7.7. Round 1 is already near zero. Local performance is normal (AUC 0.822, CITL -0.017 at round 20), so the pattern points to free-riding rather than a data fault.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with the all-client views of client_updates, client_performance, drift_by_round, feature_summary and subgroup_outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income), then checked suspects with narrower queries. Three clients (MD, OH, SC) show a clear free-rider pattern: in many rounds, including round 1, their uploaded updates have near-zero norm, which is what returning the global model without training produces. Their local performance is normal, so there is no sign of a data fault. Other leads did not hold up: WA's large update norm fits its size (z=+3.2 after size adjustment) and its performance is normal. The drift flags for VI, MI and AK are noisy with no sustained shift. The subgroup O/E outliers (FL, MD, IN, SC by age; MS, WV, MT by income; AK and AR by sex) are small-subgroup noise, with no consistent under-diagnosis pattern (FNR not elevated). No label-noise or prevalence-shift signal stood out in client_performance, and no sentinel-code signal stood out in feature tails. The budget is fully spent (0 left).
